abstract: BACKGROUND: Recently we have shown that the matricellular CCN3 protein expressed in invasive extravillous trophoblast cells (EVTs) is decreased in early-onset pre-eclampsia and is regulated by oxygen tension. Pathogenesis of pre-eclampsia relies on a shallow invasion of EVTs into the spiral arteries, which leads to hypoxia accompanied by uteroplacental insufficiency. Here we investigated the function of glycosylated and non-glycosylated CCN3 protein on cell growth as well as migration and invasion properties of the malignant trophoblast cell line Jeg3 which is a widely used model for the invasive trophoblast. METHODS AND RESULTS: Stable transfection of Jeg3 choriocarcinoma cells with full length CCN3 resulted in high expression of secreted glycosylated and cellular non-glycosylated CCN3. These cells revealed significantly reduced growth in cell numbers combined with a significantly increased migratory and invasive capacity. Matrix metalloprotease (MMP)-2 and MMP-9 activities were enhanced dependent on CCN3 expression, which could be confirmed by CCN3 knockdown studies. Using recombinant glycosylated and non-glycosylated CCN3, we revealed that CCN3 decreased growth in Jeg3 cell numbers independent of its glycosylation status, whereas only non-glycosylated CCN3 was able to enhance migration and invasion properties. CONCLUSIONS: The present results suggest that CCN3 protein regulates the decrease in Jeg3 cell numbers independent of its glycosylation status, whereas migratory and invasive properties are influenced only by non-glycosylated CCN3. An impaired balance in the expression of glycosylated and non-glycosylated CCN3 could contribute to the shallow invasion of EVTs observed in pre-eclampsia.
abstract_ja:
背景：最近、侵襲性絨毛外栄養膜細胞（EVT）に発現する基質細胞性タンパク質CCN3が、早発型妊娠高血圧腎症で減少しており、酸素分圧により制御されることを示した。妊娠高血圧腎症の病態は、EVTのらせん動脈への浅い侵入に依存しており、それが子宮胎盤不全を伴う低酸素状態をもたらす。本研究では、侵襲性栄養膜細胞の広く用いられるモデルである悪性栄養膜細胞株Jeg3の増殖、遊走、浸潤能に対する、糖鎖修飾型および非糖鎖修飾型CCN3タンパクの機能を検討した。
方法と結果：全長CCN3を安定導入したJeg3絨毛癌細胞では、分泌型の糖鎖修飾CCN3と細胞内の非糖鎖修飾CCN3が高発現した。これらの細胞は細胞数の増殖が有意に低下し、遊走・浸潤能が有意に増加した。MMP-2およびMMP-9の活性はCCN3発現に依存して増強され、CCN3ノックダウン実験でも確認された。組換え糖鎖修飾型および非糖鎖修飾型CCN3を用いると、CCN3は糖鎖修飾の状態にかかわらずJeg3細胞数を減少させたが、遊走と浸潤能を高めたのは非糖鎖修飾型CCN3のみであった。
結論：本結果は、CCN3タンパクが糖鎖修飾の状態に関係なくJeg3細胞数の減少を調節する一方、遊走・浸潤能は非糖鎖修飾型CCN3によってのみ影響されることを示唆する。糖鎖修飾型と非糖鎖修飾型CCN3の発現バランスの異常は、妊娠高血圧腎症で観察されるEVTの浅い侵入に寄与しうる。
